comparison.objective: Read an analog clock and set a digital bedside clock to the same time by counted button presses.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual time interpretation and repeated discrete button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Digital time must be 4:39–4:41 for full credit; right minutes with hour off by one earns partial credit.
comparison.reason: Tests perception, arithmetic, and counted pressing rather than dexterous tool use, fracture, or fragment recovery.
